description: The bar chart, titled "Targets" and sourced from the paper "The Unseen Targets of Hate -- A Systematic Review of Hateful Communication Datasets," illustrates the number of datasets published each year from 2012 to 2022, categorized by whether the hate speech was "Targeted" or "Untargeted." The horizontal x-axis represents the year, with data points for each year from 2012 to 2022. The vertical y-axis, labeled "Number of datasets," is scaled from 0 to 160 in increments of 20. The chart uses stacked bars to show the total number of datasets for each year, with the lower portion of each bar (blue) representing "Untargeted" datasets and the upper portion (orange) representing "Targeted" datasets. The data reveals a consistent increase in the number of datasets over the years, with a particularly sharp rise after 2017. In 2012, there was one "Untargeted" dataset. By 2022, the total number of datasets reached 40, with 10 being "Untargeted" (blue) and 30 being "Targeted" (orange). The number of "Targeted" datasets grew significantly, reaching a peak of 100 in 2021, while the number of "Untargeted" datasets peaked at 65 in the same year.
